auth.title: Authentication & Web Access Control

notifications.title: Notification Channels & Alerts
notifications.desc: Receive direct mobile alerts when important events occur in Kaizen.
notifications.whatsappDesc: Send direct alerts to your personal WhatsApp without configuring servers.
notifications.discordDesc: Receive styled embeds in your private Discord channel.
notifications.telegramDesc: Receive notifications through the server's Telegram bot.
notifications.eventsDesc: Select which notifications you want to receive on your active channels.
notifications.eventMangaRequestDesc: Alerts you when a manga you requested is downloaded and ready to read.
notifications.eventFavoriteChapterDesc: Alerts you when a new chapter of any of your favorited series is downloaded.
notifications.eventSourceDeactivatedDesc: Immediate alert if a scraper fails 5 consecutive times and gets disabled.
notifications.eventDownloadFailedDesc: Alert if a chapter fails download or archive integrity is corrupted.
notifications.eventNewMangaRequestDesc: Alert when a reader creates a new manga request.

notifications.serverSyncSuccess: Server notification settings copied to your profile.
notifications.langDesc: Choose which language you prefer for personal alerts and digests.

adminNotifications.digestDesc: Prevents API rate-limiting / ban (CallMeBot) and notification flooding by bundling batch scraper errors and downloads into a consolidated report.
adminNotifications.digestModeDesc: How often consolidated digests are dispatched
adminNotifications.digestHourDesc: Time of day to send the daily digest report
adminNotifications.serverLanguageDesc: Language for system-wide alerts and activity digests
adminNotifications.whatsappDesc: Send direct alerts to WhatsApp without running dedicated bots.
adminNotifications.whatsappPhoneDesc: Phone number with international country code (e.g. +34...)
adminNotifications.whatsappApiKeyDesc: API key obtained from CallMeBot on WhatsApp

adminNotifications.discordDesc: Send structured alert cards to a Discord channel via webhook.

adminNotifications.telegramDesc: Send notifications using a dedicated Telegram bot.
adminNotifications.telegramChatIdDesc: Target Chat ID or Channel ID
